cohort: 601,247 singleton pregnancies in Finland from 2006 to 2016
finding: While daily delivery volume had no significant effect on most obstetric interventions at the ecosystem level, smaller hospitals tended to perform fewer interventions on busy days, while larger hospitals performed more.
mod_finding: The study examined the impact of delivery volume on obstetric interventions, finding that smaller hospitals performed fewer unplanned cesarean sections on busy days while larger hospitals performed more instrumental deliveries.
